sections.heading: Description
sections.content: Prepares the organization for internal and external security audits. Includes documentation, evidence collection, and gap analysis. Aligns with standards like ISO 27001, SOC 2, and NIST. Engages stakeholders across departments. Supports continuous improvement and certification efforts.

sections.heading: Business Value
sections.content: Reduces risk of audit failure and penalties. Enhances credibility with customers and partners. Supports regulatory and contractual obligations. Improves internal governance and accountability. Builds confidence in security maturity and transparency.
